title: Two crews, one relay
text: Split into Team Alpha and Team Beta. Each crew has a secret five-letter access code to crack.

title: Send three clues
text: Each turn one sender gets a secret word and types three one-word clues for their crew.

title: The other crew jams one
text: Before your crew sees them, a jammer from the other crew swaps one clue for a fake.

title: Guess out loud, then crack the code
text: Your crew calls out its guess. Right? Reveal one letter of your code, or risk the turn and guess all five.

title: Signal lost
text: Miss, and the other crew decodes a letter instead. First crew to complete its code takes the relay!
